{{Quote|Don't worry, ''R7'': it's just a ''scratch''! I've a nasty feeling things are going to get a ''lot'' worse...|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[R7-A7/Legends|R7-A7]]|<ref name="Feral Queen">{{TCWComicCite|6.21|The Feral Queen}}</ref>}}
[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] under the tutelage of [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[Color/Legends|red]] '''[[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]]''' with white markings for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:Ahsoka_Blue_Leader.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Ahsoka, flying her Delta-7B during the Battle of Ryloth]]
{{Quote|Are you ''sure'', Artoo? We can't afford to lose the starboard cannon. Can't you ''fix it''?|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="MilkRun">{{TCWComicCite|6.6|Milk Run to Maarka!}}</ref>}}
The Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, during the Clone Wars was red with a white emblem of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] covering the entire hull of the ship. The ship was armed with dual [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and carried an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] for [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] and on-board repair.<ref name="SWPM" /><ref name="SoR" /> The ship was modified to enhance systems used during [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]].<ref name="SWPM" />

==History==
{{Quote|Where have you ''been'', Snips?''"<br />"''Nice to see you ''too'', Master Skywalker.''"<br />"''And what happened to your ''ship''? You went ''joyriding'' in the asteroid field?|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="MilkRun" />}}
Ahsoka flew as [[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]] with [[R7-A7/Legends|R7-A7]] in her Delta-7B during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] in the years of the Clone Wars, and later helped her master fight [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class droid bombers]] above [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] while [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] fought to enter the city.<ref name="SoR" />

Ahsoka later used the fighter to break through the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] blockade of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] while [[Jedi General/Legends|Generals]] Anakin Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] invaded the planet.

==Behind the scenes==
[[WizKids Games]], before its operations were discontinued by [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]], provided a sneak peak at Ahsoka's Delta-7B as a game piece in an [[Clone Wars (PocketModels)|expansion]] of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'' game before it debuted in "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]," the 19th episode in [[Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' animated television TV series]].<ref name="SWPM" /><ref name="SoR" />

A [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] set called "Ahsoka's Starfighter and Vulture Droid" was also produced that featured Ahsoka's starfighter&mdash;along with a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]]&mdash;in late December 2008, months before its television appearance.

Ahsoka's Delta-7B has hull graphics identical in all but color to [[Saesee Tiin's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Saesee Tiin's Delta-7B]]. This is similar to the case in which [[Adi Gallia's Jedi Starfighter/Legends|Adi Gallia's Delta-7B]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]'' feature like graphics with different color schemes, and suggests that the production team of ''The Clone Wars'' television series reused graphics.<ref name="SoR" /><ref name="CR">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref>
